config.authorization: Owner explicitly requested Phase 3 in this session, including actual matched-state counterfactual TRAIN evidence and PPO-only versus PPO+CF experimentation. Start GPU training only after verified completed Phase 2 parent; final evaluation remains sealed.
config.checkpoint_retention: Two latest complete paired resume states plus every DEV candidate; immutable selected actors and raw evidence retained
config.counterfactual_pair_rule: Positive empirical paired utility lower interval and no casualty increase in any measured fire replicate; behavior-relative joint margin; explicitly offline
config.curriculum_control: PPO-only TRAIN metrics choose one shared curriculum for both arms
config.evaluation: Fixed 32 selection and 32 reporting families. Equal matched update rounds for PPO-only and PPO+CF, same frozen parent and initial optimizer. Compare original V1, V1 with external mask and coordination (reporting only), Phase2, both continuations and default frozen T0–T4; record timed-out teacher episodes as incomplete.
excluded_inputs: EMBERBench hidden scenarios and internal simulator
config.memory_policy: One untruncated public state per GPU forward; stage4 grows to24-32people, with exact-parent largest-state differentiable memory preflight before training
config.parent: Completed and independently verified DEV-selected r21-online-ppo@1 checkpoint, exact identity bound before any Phase3 training
config.policy: PPO remains primary, unmasked complete joint actions; separately labeled offline measured-outcome pair loss only in CF arm. Fixed frozen T1 continuation, original and seven matched future-fire forks for stochastic TRAIN states.
config.visit_priority: One candidate visit per episode, top four by (3*repeated ineffective + 2*wall or boundary + 2*coordination conflict + bottleneck + delayed adjacent escape)/active people; seeded deterministic tie break. Uses public state and current/prior sampled intents only.
